tokens.name: night-000
tokens.usage: Page background, the app canvas behind everything. The darkest night; banners and the logo are drawn on it.

tokens.name: night-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sidebars and the chat column: one step up from the page.

tokens.name: night-200
tokens.usage: Inputs, code blocks, table headers and anything raised inside a card.

tokens.name: night-300
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, pressed ghost buttons. Not a text ground for ink-faint.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only: never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes): at least 3:1 on night-000, night-100 and night-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on night-000, night-100, night-200 and night-300 (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions and metadata on night-000 through night-300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, timestamps and HUD labels on night-000, night-100 and night-200 only.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary action fill, the active nav item, the hyphen in the wordmark. As text: on night-000, night-100, night-200 or magenta-soft.

tokens.name: on-magenta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a magenta fill (the primary button label). Dark in the dark theme, because neon magenta is too light for white.

tokens.name: magenta-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind magenta or ink text: brand badges, the selected tab underlay.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Amy's colour: anything the AI says, does or suggests, the AI in the wordmark, links and focus. As text: on night-000 through night-300 or cyan-soft.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cyan fill (an "Ask Amy" button).

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for Amy's chat bubbles and AI suggestions; ink or cyan text on it.

tokens.name: sunset
tokens.usage: Second sun band. Highlights, charts and illustration; as text, on night-000 through night-200.

tokens.name: solar
tokens.usage: Top sun band. Highlights and warnings; as text, on night-000 through night-200.

tokens.name: on-solar
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solar fill (a warning chip).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and "online" states, always with an icon or word. As text, on night-000 through night-200.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, an alias of solar; always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with an icon or word: it sits close to magenta in lightness, so never rely on hue to tell them apart. As text, on night-000 through night-200.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, an alias of cyan.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour, an alias of cyan: at least 3:1 on every night surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines and product names only. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on marketing and empty states. Never for body copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Amy summarised the three docs you shared this morning.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Set in uppercase (text-transform). Nav group labels, table headers, HUD tags.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands, file paths and IDs.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Status readouts and system labels; uppercase. Cyan for Amy, ink-faint otherwise.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; between stacked form rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gutters between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; space between sections in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and banner margins.

radius.note: Sharp by default: corners are square or barely softened. Use cut-* for the cyberpunk clipped corner instead of big radii.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for cards, panels, buttons and the banner frame.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, tooltips and menus.

cut.note: Clipped corners (chamfers), applied with clip-path on the top-left and bottom-right corners.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and badges.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels and large tiles. The app icon cuts one eighth of its side (64 of 512).

shadow.note: No soft drop shadows on dark: depth comes from surface steps. Neon glow is reserved for focus and for Amy.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px of solid cyan.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Amy is thinking or speaking: her avatar and the live chat bubble. Nothing else glows cyan.

tokens.name: glow-magenta
tokens.usage: Hover on the one primary action per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs: anything floating above the page.
